mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_helpful = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helpful_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_helpful = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_helpful_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rating IS NOT NULL THEN rating END), 2) AS avg_rating, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN is_helpful = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_helpful IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1 ) AS helpful_rate FROM ai_feedback
